title: Keystone — Legal Ombudsman public interest decision
text:
Final Decision
11 September 2025
Introduction
As explained in the Case and Provisional Decisions already issued, this is a
complaint about the work Keystone Law Limited (the firm) did for Mrs
The firm was instructed in October 2018 to help Mrs make a claim against her
local council. The firm stopped working on 29 September 2023 after Mrs raised
her complaint, but remained on record with the court as Mrs did not sign the
notice to indicate her representative had changed. In November 2023 Mrs did
eventually instruct alternative solicitors, who have been progressing matters on her
behalf since.
The Legal Ombudsman has agreed to investigate the following points of complaint:
1. The firm failed to comply with the Directions Order of July 2022 when it
failed to serve Mrs witness statement to the other side, referencing
each item sought and its relevance to the pleaded case.
2. The firm failed to contact the Court, between July and November , to
gain an update on the sealed order.
3. The firm failed to tell Mrs that the other side had made an application to
strike out her entire claim in December
4. The firm failed to serve Mrs witness statement by the April 2023
deadline.
5. The firm failed to make an application for an Unless Order, despite Mrs
requests.
6. The firm failed to tell Mrs that the other side had made an application to
strike out her entire claim on August 2023.
7. The firm failed to serve a defence to the other side’s strike out application of
August 2023.
8. The firm failed to inform Mrs that a hearing for the other side's application
to strike out her claim had been listed for November 2023.
9. Upon reopening Mrs complaint on 31 October 2023, the firm failed to
issue a final response in a timely manner
